assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original transparent full-body character portrait and visual reference for a warm PC adventure game. Create one adorable anthropomorphic female RAGDOLL CAT postal traveler, standing naturally on two short hind legs, full body entirely visible, three-quarter view facing slightly right, centered with generous transparent margin. This is the ragdoll cat breed, NOT a fabric doll: plush cream-white long fur, soft seal-gray ears and fluffy tail, symmetrical soft gray face markings with a white inverted-V blaze and white muzzle, vivid gentle blue eyes, tiny pink nose, little rounded paws. Youthful nonhuman cartoon proportions, large round head, soft triangular cat ears, friendly curious expression, no human anatomy. Sage-green short cape with rounded hem, small warm ochre canvas crossbody mail satchel bearing a simple envelope symbol, pale apricot scarf. Her front paw holds one cream envelope; the other relaxed. Tail curves upward kindly beside her, feet visible. Original storybook gouache and colored-pencil shading, warm cream/ochre/sage palette, readable clean silhouette, restrained detail that a matching small in-game puppet can reproduce. Genuine transparent alpha background, no scenery, no ground plane, no frame, no text, no watermark. One character only. The cat must look clearly feline and ragdoll, never fox-like: rounded broad muzzle, short nose, cool brown-gray points, no orange fur, no long pointed snout.

assets.draftPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create an animation puppet PARTS ATLAS of the supplied original ragdoll cat postal traveler, preserving her exact cream fluffy fur, gray ears and tail, blue eyes, sage cape, apricot scarf, ochre mail satchel and gouache-pencil style. Transparent alpha background. Landscape image, exactly FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS and TWO EQUAL ROWS, eight isolated parts, one centered in each invisible equal cell, generous transparent padding at every cell edge. No drawn grid, no labels, no letters, no shadows, no additional complete characters. All parts oriented as a standing three-quarter cat facing slightly RIGHT, neutral attachment-ready pose; each part fully opaque within its own silhouette, no holes. TOP ROW from left to right: (1) complete cat HEAD including ears, cheek fur, blue eyes, tiny nose and white blaze, no neck/body/scarf; (2) rounded TORSO wearing sage short cape and apricot scarf, with cream tummy below, NO head, NO arms, NO legs, NO bag; (3) fluffy curved gray TAIL alone, attachment at lower right; (4) small ochre MAIL SATCHEL alone, envelope symbol, no long strap. BOTTOM ROW left to right: (5) left cream upper arm and rounded paw, full short hanging arm, no envelope; (6) right cream upper arm and rounded paw, full short hanging arm, holding small cream envelope; (7) left short cream LEG AND FOOT, rounded toe pointing slightly right, no torso; (8) right short cream LEG AND FOOT, rounded toe pointing slightly right, no torso. Each cell contains exactly its one listed cutout. These are independent sprite pieces for a gentle, coherent run cycle: keep all silhouettes clean, the same cat identity and tactile texture. Preserve genuine transparency. No full cat picture anywhere; eight separate pieces only.
assets.prompt: Precise-object-edit / transparent sprite cleanup. Keep all eight cat puppet parts in exactly the same positions, sizes, colors and shapes as this source image. Change ONLY the gray checkerboard background: REMOVE every checkerboard square completely and replace the entire background with genuine fully transparent ALPHA pixels. Do not draw any new checkerboard or background color. Preserve the opaque cat head, torso and scarf, tail, satchel, both arms and both legs, all original textured fur and clean soft edges. Export a true RGBA PNG with transparency. No crop, no repositioning, no text, no new elements.
assets.qa: The first atlas output was RGB with a drawn checkerboard and was rejected. The edited output is RGBA; independent background samples were alpha 0 or 1. Parts were not a strict equal grid, so the runtime identifies each silhouette rather than assuming equal cells.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an original landscape title-screen painting for a gentle PC adventure about a RAGDOLL CAT delivering letters to faraway animal friends. Use the supplied image ONLY as the cat character reference, preserving cream fur, gray ears and fluffy tail, blue eyes, sage-green short cape, apricot scarf and ochre envelope mail bag. New scene, wide 3:2 landscape gouache/colored-pencil storybook art, refined warm natural light, creamy paper texture. On the RIGHT third foreground, the same small anthropomorphic cat is seen three-quarter from behind on a flower-lined path, looking toward the distant route, a tiny translucent mint CAT companion beside her, both full body and visibly feline. A little wooden mailbox and a warmly lit post office nestle on the right edge. In the middle distance a walkable path winds from a soft leafy forest past a blue lake toward warm rocky hills and a sunlit snowy peak, gentle welcoming scale, no danger. LEFT HALF intentionally quiet with pale cream sky, soft meadow and atmospheric trees, low detail and enough contrast-free negative space for a readable game title and menu added later in code. Upper-left especially plain light cream. Warm apricot sunlight, sage foliage, dusty turquoise lake, bright snow, hand-painted details and cozy flowers. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no frame, no watermark. Do not include any fox, human, dark ruined city, or grim imagery. The picture should feel like a kind invitation to go somewhere, not an action game poster.
